fitness.judgment: High: a subtle universal paper grain for the existing blank shallow card props and notebook UI.

visualInspection.method: Original PNG viewed without modification and compared with component-board, held-journal and workshop Paper Theatre references.
visualInspection.result: Accepted: clean near-white paper with faint even fibers; no writing, folds, strong stains, hard shading or distressed details.

uses: Small paper signs and printed labels

minorAdjustment.materialRecipe: BaseColor = Cream * lerp(1, PaperColor.rgb, GrainAmount). Use a color texture sample with sRGB enabled.

uiImport.note: A fixed UI card can sample the original non-power-of-two image directly.

worldCardImport.note: For world props, pad during Unreal import so the engine can generate mips without editing the source. Keep UVs in the original 600-row content region and check the import preview before applying the material.
